hint_move.text: Use WASD or the arrow keys to move

hint_quest.text: Opal's notes are on the left side of the screen. Use them as a guide.

bennet_bar_dialogue.speaker: Opal
bennet_bar_dialogue.text: Been a while since I've seen you Bennet, what are you having tonight?

bennet_bar_dialogue.speaker: Opal
bennet_bar_dialogue.text: Good to hear, he was really cute.

bennet_bar_dialogue.speaker: Opal
bennet_bar_dialogue.text: How's the business going by the way?

bennet_bar_dialogue.speaker: Bennet
bennet_bar_dialogue.text: There isn't a lack of clients but my hands aren't as steady as they used to be.

bennet_bar_dialogue.speaker: Bennet
bennet_bar_dialogue.text: I'm going to have to close down the workshop im afraid.

bennet_bar_dialogue.speaker: Opal
bennet_bar_dialogue.text: I'm quite sorry to hear that, who's gonna help me when I get locked out now?

bennet_bar_dialogue.speaker: Bennet
bennet_bar_dialogue.text: Oh I'm sure there's plenty of reputable locksmiths around here Opal, I'm sure you'll find someone capable.

bennet_bar_dialogue.speaker: Opal
bennet_bar_dialogue.text: Have that last drink on the house, we're about to close out for the night.

bennet_bar_dialogue.speaker: Bennet
bennet_bar_dialogue.text: You have a nice night now.

bennet_bar_repeat.speaker: Bennet
bennet_bar_repeat.text: You have a nice night now.

locked_door.speaker: Opal
locked_door.text: Goddamn it, forgot the key again.

need_money.speaker: Opal
need_money.text: I should grab my money before going that way...

grabbed_keys.speaker: Opal
grabbed_keys.text: There you are, gotta stop forgetting this...

going_to_bed_home.speaker: Opal
going_to_bed_home.text: I should stop sneaking in drinks at work...

first_onyx_cutscene.speaker: Onyx
first_onyx_cutscene.text: That little Vial of yours is really annoying you know?

first_onyx_cutscene.speaker: Onyx
first_onyx_cutscene.text: I never get to hang around.

first_onyx_cutscene.speaker: Opal
first_onyx_cutscene.text: And why do you think that is?

first_onyx_cutscene.speaker: Opal
first_onyx_cutscene.text: I don't even get to sleep well and you show up immediately.

first_onyx_cutscene.speaker: Onyx
first_onyx_cutscene.text: Well you did need it… You look way worse than usual ;)

first_onyx_cutscene_pt2.speaker: Opal
first_onyx_cutscene_pt2.text: Spit it out! I have things to do.

first_onyx_cutscene_pt2.speaker: Onyx
first_onyx_cutscene_pt2.text: Out of all your weird habits sleepwalking isn't one of them, is it?

first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.speaker: Opal
first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.text: Where the fuck is it? Did someone get in?

first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.speaker: Opal
first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.text: Why didn't they grab the money?

first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.speaker: Onyx
first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.text: Maybe they're just really into weird looking glass containers?

first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.speaker: Opal
first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.text: Shut the fuck up! I need to think.

first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.speaker: Opal
first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.text: I think that creep from the bar was following me last night...

first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.speaker: Onyx
first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.text: Maybe if you were doing something other than drinking on the job, you would remember things more clearly.

first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.speaker: Opal
first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.text: I gotta find Finley, he was drinking with that creep last night.

first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.speaker: Onyx
first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.text: Guess you get to enjoy my company a little longer ;)

first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.speaker: Opal
first_onyx_cutscene_pt3.text: I need to hurry up. I can't bear Onyx for too long...

grabbed_money.speaker: Opal
grabbed_money.text: Never hurts to have full pockets.

finley_questions.speaker: Opal
finley_questions.text: Finley, I need to talk to you.

finley_questions.speaker: Finley
finley_questions.text: Hey Opal, I'm so sorry I didn't pay my tab yesterday.

finley_questions.speaker: Opal
finley_questions.text: I'm not here about that Finley, I need to ask you some questions

finley_questions.speaker: Finley
finley_questions.text: Sure thing I guess... What do you need to know?

finley_questions.speaker: Opal
finley_questions.text: That person you were drinking with yesterday, you know them well?

finley_questions.speaker: Finley
finley_questions.text: Not really, I try to make small talk but they barely answer

finley_questions.speaker: Opal
finley_questions.text: Do you know anything about them? I need to find them.

finley_questions.speaker: Finley
finley_questions.text: I guess they like yellow? They had a really pretty pocket watch with some sort of yellow stuff embedded in it.

finley_questions.speaker: Opal
finley_questions.text: Did you at least see where they went after they left?

finley_questions.speaker: Finley
finley_questions.text: Not yesterday, but they always seem to head straight down the street that's right outside your house.

finley_questions.speaker: Opal
finley_questions.text: Not now Finley, I don't have time

locked_grace_door.speaker: Opal
locked_grace_door.text: I need to get in, the Vial has got to be there.

locked_grace_door.speaker: Opal
locked_grace_door.text: Bennet lives somewhere around here, maybe he could help.

bennet_cat_interact.speaker: Opal
bennet_cat_interact.text: It's that stray Bennet is taking care of.

bennet_help.speaker: Opal
bennet_help.text: Hey Bennet, how's the day treating you?

bennet_help.speaker: Bennet
bennet_help.text: Same as always, not much to do.

bennet_help.speaker: Opal
bennet_help.text: To be honest I'm interested in learning how to lockpick, thought about it all night after you said you're closing down the workshop.

bennet_help.speaker: Bennet
bennet_help.text: Really? I'd love to teach you!

bennet_help.speaker: Bennet
bennet_help.text: I'm afraid I sold my tools though, you're going to have to wait while I procure some new ones.

bennet_help.speaker: Opal
bennet_help.text: I can get them for you! I'd rather start as soon as possible.

bennet_help.speaker: Bennet
bennet_help.text: Well there might be some spare picks in one of the abandoned warehouses around here, but you're going to have to look around for them...

bennet_help.speaker: Bennet
bennet_help.text: I'm afraid I'm also going to have to ask you for a few drinks Opal, they help my hands not be so shaky.

bennet_help.speaker: Opal
bennet_help.text: Sure thing, I'll find the lockpicks and bring back a bottle.

bennet_help.speaker: Bennet
bennet_help.text: I'm glad to see you're eager to learn, I'll wait for you to come back.

bennet_help.speaker: Bennet
bennet_help.text: And don't fall for the cats tricks, I already fed him!

bennet_help.speaker: Opal
bennet_help.text: I'll keep it in mind, thank you Bennet.

hidden_item_interact.speaker: Opal
hidden_item_interact.text: Looks like a lockpicking set, but rusted but it should work for Bennet.

grab_bar_bottle.speaker: Opal
grab_bar_bottle.text: I've drank more than enough of these, what's one more off my own books?

bennet_interact_bottle_only.speaker: Bennet
bennet_interact_bottle_only.text: Thank you Opal, I really appreciate it.

bennet_interact_bottle_only.speaker: Opal
bennet_interact_bottle_only.text: It's no problem Bennet, you're the one helping me here

bennet_interact_bottle_only.speaker: Opal
bennet_interact_bottle_only.text: I'll return once I find some lockpicks

bennet_interact_lockpicks_only.speaker: Bennet
bennet_interact_lockpicks_only.text: They're a bit worn but they should work for a beginner.

bennet_interact_lockpicks_only.speaker: Opal
bennet_interact_lockpicks_only.text: I'll return with the drinks then.

bennet_interact_with_both_items.speaker: Bennet
bennet_interact_with_both_items.text: You're just going to watch me open this lock for now, ok?
(Bennet opens the lock slowly, carefully explaining each step to you.

bennet_interact_with_both_items.speaker: Opal
bennet_interact_with_both_items.text: Doesn't seem too hard, mind if I give it a try?

bennet_interact_with_both_items.speaker: Bennet
bennet_interact_with_both_items.text: Go ahead, tell me if you struggle with something
(You follow Bennet's guide and open the lock with ease.

bennet_interact_with_both_items.speaker: Bennet
bennet_interact_with_both_items.text: Seems like you're a natural Opal, that was really good!

bennet_interact_with_both_items.speaker: Opal
bennet_interact_with_both_items.text: Thanks Bennet, guess your skill rubbed off on me.

bennet_interact_with_both_items.speaker: Opal
bennet_interact_with_both_items.text: I need to be on my way now though, I have some things to do.

bennet_interact_with_both_items.speaker: Bennet
bennet_interact_with_both_items.text: Of course, it got a bit late with all the searching around you had to do.

bennet_interact_with_both_items.speaker: Bennet
bennet_interact_with_both_items.text: Take the pick set with you so you can keep practicing, I hope to see you again soon for another class.

bennet_interact_with_both_items.speaker: Opal
bennet_interact_with_both_items.text: I'll try my best to find the time for it, see you around Bennet.

bennet_interact_with_both_items.speaker: Opal
bennet_interact_with_both_items.text: (I should be able to open that door now.)

grace_clue_2.speaker: Opal
grace_clue_2.text: All of these look similar, but there's something off about them...

grace_clue_3.speaker: Opal
grace_clue_3.text: I don't even know what this is, I'm at a loss.

grace_right_clue.speaker: Opal
grace_right_clue.text: Mental Asylum papers? I thought that dress looked weird...

grace_right_clue.speaker: Opal
grace_right_clue.text: Looks like there's some sort of payment letter here too.

grace_right_clue.speaker: Opal
grace_right_clue.text: Adressed to Grace huh? At least I got a name now.

grace_right_clue.speaker: Opal
grace_right_clue.text: Looks like the asylum is in the midst of the city, I'm gonna have to use the train.

grace_right_clue.speaker: Opal
grace_right_clue.text: I need to head over there and look for the bastard, can't afford to sit around here.

train_dialogue.speaker: Onyx
train_dialogue.text: Well look at you being productive for once!

train_dialogue.speaker: Opal
train_dialogue.text: I've a got a damn good incentive

train_dialogue.speaker: Opal
train_dialogue.text: Shut up, I'll get it back.

train_dialogue.speaker: Opal
train_dialogue.text: I just need to find that fucking thief.

train_dialogue.speaker: Onyx
train_dialogue.text: Oh yeah, such an adequate task for a hungover and barely functioning.

train_dialogue.speaker: Opal
train_dialogue.text: Go away, I need to think how to get into that asylum.

train_dialogue.speaker: Onyx
train_dialogue.text: Oh well, I'm gonna stick around for a while.

train_dialogue.speaker: Onyx
train_dialogue.text: I'll let you wallow in your thoughts some more.
